--- title: "Hands-on Exercise 5" author: "Min Htet Aung" description: "This is the Hands-on Exercise 5" date: "May 15, 2025" date-modified: "last-modified" format: html editor: visual execute: eval: true echo: true warning: false freeze: true --- # Getting Started ## Installing and Launching R Packages - `igraph`: Powerful package for creating, analyzing, and visualizing complex networks and graph structures. - `visNetwork`: Enables interactive, customizable network visualizations using `vis.js` in R. - `lubridate`: Simplifies parsing, handling, and arithmetic of date-time data in R. - `concaveman`: Generates accurate concave hull polygons around spatial point sets for tight boundary mapping. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(igraph, tidygraph, ggraph, visNetwork, lubridate, clock, tidyverse, graphlayouts, concaveman, ggforce) ``` ::: # Importing Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_nodes <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_node.csv") GAStech_edges <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_edge-v2.csv") ``` ::: ## Reviewing the Imported data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(GAStech_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 9,063 Columns: 8 $ source 43, 43, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 26, 26, 26… $ target 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29… $ SentDate "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014"… $ SentTime 08:39:00, 08:39:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:0… $ Subject "GT-SeismicProcessorPro Bug Report", "GT-SeismicProcessorP… $ MainSubject "Work related", "Work related", "Work related", "Work rela… $ sourceLabel "Sven.Flecha", "Sven.Flecha", "Kanon.Herrero", "Kanon.Herr… $ targetLabel "Isak.Baza", "Lucas.Alcazar", "Felix.Resumir", "Hideki.Coc… ``` ::: ::: ## Modifying the data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges <- GAStech_edges %>% mutate(SendDate = dmy(SentDate)) %>% mutate(Weekday = wday(SentDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) ``` ::: ## Reviewing the revised data fields ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(GAStech_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 9,063 Columns: 10 $ source 43, 43, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 26, 26, 26… $ target 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29… $ SentDate "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014"… $ SentTime 08:39:00, 08:39:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:0… $ Subject "GT-SeismicProcessorPro Bug Report", "GT-SeismicProcessorP… $ MainSubject "Work related", "Work related", "Work related", "Work rela… $ sourceLabel "Sven.Flecha", "Sven.Flecha", "Kanon.Herrero", "Kanon.Herr… $ targetLabel "Isak.Baza", "Lucas.Alcazar", "Felix.Resumir", "Hideki.Coc… $ SendDate 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-0… $ Weekday 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五… ``` ::: ::: ## Wrangling Attributes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(source, target, Weekday) %>% summarise(Weight = n()) %>% filter(source!=target) %>% filter(Weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ## Reviewign the Revised Edges File ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(GAStech_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 9,063 Columns: 10 $ source 43, 43, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 26, 26, 26… $ target 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29… $ SentDate "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014"… $ SentTime 08:39:00, 08:39:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:0… $ Subject "GT-SeismicProcessorPro Bug Report", "GT-SeismicProcessorP… $ MainSubject "Work related", "Work related", "Work related", "Work rela… $ sourceLabel "Sven.Flecha", "Sven.Flecha", "Kanon.Herrero", "Kanon.Herr… $ targetLabel "Isak.Baza", "Lucas.Alcazar", "Felix.Resumir", "Hideki.Coc… $ SendDate 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-0… $ Weekday 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五, 星期五… ``` ::: ::: # Creating Network Objects using tidygraph - `tbl_graph()` creates a tbl_graph network object from nodes and edges data. - `as_tbl_graph()` converts network data and objects to a tbl_graph network. Below are network data and objects supported by `as_tbl_graph()` ## The dplyr verbs in tidygraph - activate() verb from tidygraph serves as a switch between tibbles for nodes and edges. All dplyr verbs applied to `tbl_graph` object are applied to the active tibble. ## Using `tbl_graph()` to build tidygraph data model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = GAStech_nodes, edges = GAStech_edges_aggregated, directed = TRUE) ``` ::: ## Reviewing the output tidygraph’s graph object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tbl_graph: 54 nodes and 1372 edges # # A directed multigraph with 1 component # # Node Data: 54 × 4 (active) id label Department Title 1 1 Mat.Bramar Administration Assistant to CEO 2 2 Anda.Ribera Administration Assistant to CFO 3 3 Rachel.Pantanal Administration Assistant to CIO 4 4 Linda.Lagos Administration Assistant to COO 5 5 Ruscella.Mies.Haber Administration Assistant to Engineering Group Mana… 6 6 Carla.Forluniau Administration Assistant to IT Group Manager 7 7 Cornelia.Lais Administration Assistant to Security Group Manager 8 44 Kanon.Herrero Security Badging Office 9 45 Varja.Lagos Security Badging Office 10 46 Stenig.Fusil Security Building Control # ℹ 44 more rows # # Edge Data: 1,372 × 4 from to Weekday Weight 1 1 2 星期日 5 2 1 2 星期一 2 3 1 2 星期二 3 # ℹ 1,369 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## Reviewing the output tidygraph’s graph object - As can be seen from the output above, `GAStech_graph` is a tbl_graph object with 4541 edges and 54 nodes. - Additionally, the command prints the first three rows of "Edge Data" and the first six rows of "Node Data." - The Node Data is active, it says. One tibble at a time, the data can be altered thanks to the concept of an active tibble inside a tbl_graph object. ## Changing the Active Object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph %>% activate(edges) %>% arrange(desc(Weight)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tbl_graph: 54 nodes and 1372 edges # # A directed multigraph with 1 component # # Edge Data: 1,372 × 4 (active) from to Weekday Weight 1 40 41 星期六 13 2 41 43 星期一 11 3 35 31 星期二 10 4 40 41 星期一 10 5 40 43 星期一 10 6 36 32 星期日 9 7 40 43 星期六 9 8 41 40 星期一 9 9 19 15 星期三 8 10 35 38 星期二 8 # ℹ 1,362 more rows # # Node Data: 54 × 4 id label Department Title 1 1 Mat.Bramar Administration Assistant to CEO 2 2 Anda.Ribera Administration Assistant to CFO 3 3 Rachel.Pantanal Administration Assistant to CIO # ℹ 51 more rows ``` ::: ::: # Plotting Static Network Graphs with ggraph package ggraph is an extension of ggplot2, making it easier to carry over basic ggplot skills to the design of network graphs. As in all network graph, there are three main aspects to a ggraph’s network graph, they are: - nodes, - edges and - layouts. For a comprehensive discussion of each of this aspect of graph, please refer to their respective vignettes provided. ## Plotting a Basic Network Graph The code chunk below uses `ggraph()`, `geom-edge_link()` and `geom_node_point()` to plot a network graph by using `GAStech_graph`. Before your get started, it is advisable to read their respective reference guide at least once. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link() + geom_node_point() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Changing the default network graph theme ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Changing the Coloring of the plot ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes(colour = 'grey50')) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = 'grey40')) g + theme_graph(background = 'grey10', text_colour = 'white') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Fruchterman and Reingold layout ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Modifying network nodes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = 3)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-15-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Modifying edges ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 3) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Creating Facet Graphs - `facet_nodes()` whereby edges are only draw in a panel if both terminal nodes are present here, - `facet_edges()` whereby nodes are always drawn in al panels even if the node data contains an attribute named the same as the one used for the edge facetting, and - `facet_graph()` faceting on two variables simultaneously. ## Working with `facet_edges()` ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Working with `facet_edges()` ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## A Framed Facet Graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) + th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Working with `facet_nodes()` ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_nodes(~Department)+ th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-20-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Network Metrics Analysis ## Computing centrality indices ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(betweenness_centrality = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size=betweenness_centrality)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-21-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Visualising Network Metrics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = centrality_betweenness())) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-22-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Visualising Community ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_edge_betweenness( weights = Weight, directed = TRUE))) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link( aes( width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width( range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point( aes(colour = community)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-23-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% activate(nodes) %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_optimal(weights = Weight)), betweenness_measure = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_mark_hull( aes(x, y, group = community, fill = community), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.3, "cm"), # Expand radius = unit(0.3, "cm") # Smoothness ) + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(fill = Department, size = betweenness_measure), color = "black", shape = 21) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-24-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Building Interactive Network Graph with visNetwork ## Data preparation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("sourceLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(from = id) %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("targetLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(to = id) %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(from, to) %>% summarise(weight = n()) %>% filter(from!=to) %>% filter(weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ## Plotting the first interactive network graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Working with layout ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Working with visual attributes - Nodes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_nodes <- GAStech_nodes %>% rename(group = Department) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Working with visual attributes - Edges ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "curvedCW")) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Interactivity ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: :::
